_comment: A stand-in for data/reported.json, which tests of behaviour and the documentation's
pictures read instead of the live file (tests/frozen_registry.py). The live file changes
whenever a report is filed; a picture or a golden must not go stale because of that.
Sample counts for the one Codex version the pictures describe (build/make_screenshots.py,
CODEX_VERSION), so the Diagnostics card is photographed with its Reported row filled in.
Nobody filed these: they show what the row looks like, not what anyone reported.
